newsitem.title: USA: Entergy sees Ark. 2 nuke down for 3 weeks.
newsitem.headline: Entergy sees Ark. 2 nuke down for 3 weeks.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 858 megawatt (MW) Arkansas 2 nuclear unit, shut late Saturday for repairs, is expected to remain off line for about three weeks, the company said Monday.
"We need to make repairs to steam generator tubes," company spokesman Terry Young said.
The unit is located in Russellville, Ark.
Separately, Entergy's 936 MW River Bend nuclear unit, which was reduced to 60 percent power this weekend, is likely to return to full power Tuesday, Young said.
The St Francisville, La., unit was shut to replace a bearing in an isophase bus duct cooling fan, he said.
